text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-, six-, nine- and 12-month treasury bills on February 6 fell from the previous sale on February 4, a central bank statement said on Friday.

Three-month bills slipped to 32.29 percent from 32.47 percent, six-month bills fell to 35.67 percent from 38.40 percent, nine-month bills edged down to 36.36 from 40.96 percent and 12-month bills fell to 37.07 percent from 43.78 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15 million hryvnia 15 million hryvnia
Amount sold 7.93 million UAH 7.46 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.34 million UAH 6.91 million UAH
The central bank sold 79,275 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 18,669 were competitive and 60,606 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of Thursday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 17 million hryvnia 17 million hryvnia
Amount sold 16.05 million UAH 7.24 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.63 million UAH 6.07 million UAH
The central bank sold 160,489 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 122,458 were competitive and 38,031 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of Thursday's auction of nine-month discount T-bills were as follows:
Issue volume 20 million hryvnia 19 million hryvnia
Amount sold 19.22 million UAH 16.54 million UAH
Actual amount raised 15.11 million UAH 12.66 million UAH
The central bank sold 192,248 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 114,976 were competitive and 77,272 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of Thursday's 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 22 million hryvnia 20 million hryvnia
Amount sold 22.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 16.06 million UAH 13.92 million UAH
The central bank sold 220,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 10,000 were competitive and 210,000 non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
